verdict.rationale: Resend supports webhooks that fire on email events (resend-docs-6) and explicitly mentions building 'recurring flows with automations' for marketing contacts/segments (resend-docs-12), which suggests some event-triggered automation exists. However, there's no documentation of a general-purpose rule engine (e.g., 'if event X then action Y' conditions) beyond marketing broadcast automations, and webhooks require external systems to implement the actual trigger logic rather than Resend itself executing rules. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the automations/flows feature (conditions, triggers, actions), evidence of transactional-event rule definitions, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this automation feature works as described.
